tutorial.label: Tutorial
tutorial.hint: Your face in a medium circle at the bottom left, with your voice. The usual setup for how-to videos.

present.label: Presentation
present.hint: A small circle at the bottom right so it stays out of the way of slides, with your voice.

big.label: Big face
big.hint: A large rounded square at the bottom right. Good for a short message with something on screen behind you.

screen.label: Screen and voice
screen.hint: No camera. Records the screen with your voice only.

silent.label: Screen only
silent.hint: No camera and no microphone. Records the screen as a silent video.
